description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git merge behaviors, including recursive merge operations, renaming, and conflict resolution. It defines test cases that set up repositories, create branches, perform file modifications and renames, and execute merges to verify expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of a command sequence.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all test cases.
